name: Eduardo Rubén Bernal Puente
headline: Junior Data Analyst at Mercado Libre, analytics engineering for Mercado Pago Point. Data Science at ITAM, class of 2028.
tagline: I keep a field sales channel's data correct, on time and usable by the people who run it.
summary: Data Science student at ITAM (graduating May 2028) working as a Junior Data Analyst at Mercado Libre since November 2025. I own the BigQuery data warehouse layer of Rangers, Mercado Pago Point's field-agent channel in Mexico: ETL/ELT pipelines, data quality, and the dashboards and internal tools built on top. SQL and Python in production, with tests and code review. Machine learning and parallel computing projects at university.
personalIntro: Off the clock I'm Rubo: a music nerd, a gamer and someone who will lose an evening to a telescope. This universe is the informal one.

softSkills.name: Team leadership
softSkills.evidence: Led a four-member AIESEC team through the attraction-to-realization pipeline (nine international volunteers placed) and mentor two colleagues on the data tooling at Mercado Libre.

softSkills.name: Stakeholder communication
softSkills.evidence: Weekly planning and one-to-ones with operations, invoicing, payouts, cashback and measurement teams; monthly and quarterly business reviews; earlier, international coordination in English at AIESEC.

softSkills.name: Documentation and knowledge transfer
softSkills.evidence: Architecture notes, changelogs and handoffs kept current so the team can operate and extend what I build without me.

softSkills.name: Ownership under ambiguity
softSkills.evidence: Took over the Rangers data layer two months after joining and rebuilt a twelve-step manual process into one parameterised job while the backend was being migrated.

softSkills.name: Data quality mindset
softSkills.evidence: Audit steps that stop a job before an error spreads, same-day response to alerts, anomaly checks that surfaced two irregular cases for investigation.

softSkills.name: Research coordination
softSkills.evidence: Research Manager at DataLab ITAM: planned and documented the ECOBOX AI work so a student team with exams could still deliver a model and a paper.

softSkills.name: Long-term discipline
softSkills.evidence: Fifteen years of swimming and more than a decade of piano alongside a full course load and a job.
